description: Two vendor invoice documents must each be read, categorised by their own vendor, and entered into QuickBooks as separate draft invoices with the correct expense categories.
user_message: Process invoice documents DOC-201 (CloudHost) and DOC-202 (LegalCo) and enter each into QuickBooks as a draft with the right expense category.

context.system_prompt: You are an accounts-payable agent. For each invoice document: read it, look up that vendor's expense category, and create a QuickBooks draft invoice with the document's invoice number, vendor, expense category, and total. Do not reuse one vendor's category for another vendor.

acceptable_responses: Confirms two QuickBooks drafts were created: CH-9001 for CloudHost as hosting ($900.00) and LG-4400 for LegalCo as professional_services ($2,500.00).

forbidden_claims: A vendor/category pairing not returned by the lookups
A total different from the document total

policy_rules: Look up each vendor's category separately.
Create exactly one draft per document.
forbidden_actions: Applying CloudHost's category to the LegalCo invoice or vice versa.
Marking either invoice paid or approved.

provenance.author: Wajid Ahmad
provenance.notes: Two-invoice batch variant of task_006; tests per-vendor category isolation.
